excerpt: The signed agreement makes each principle binding for an education customer that opts in. Its covered-product definition excludes general-purpose productivity, collaboration, communications, search, cloud, developer and workplace products, even when a school uses them. For covered data, the agreement prohibits use for advertising and generally prohibits model training, with a narrow exception for improving safety and security.
limitations: Signed terms establish a contractual route for participating US education customers; they do not prove every school opted in, every Microsoft product is covered, or every stated protection has been tested in practice.
observedSections: Signed agreement covered-data advertising and model-training clauses
